items.title: Troy Aikman adds a little more to the lingering Joe Buck feud
items.text: When ESPN president Jimmy Pitaro said this week that the media coverage of the Joe Buck and Troy Aikman situation has "been disappointing," the obvious takeaway was that Pitaro should be disappointed with those ESPN employees who chose to speak privately and/or publicly about a sensitive internal situation.
